task_context.message_text: Write a formal institutional reply informing the sender that their request has been received and is currently under review, and that a detailed response will be provided within five working days.

sections.title: Status Update
sections.purpose: Inform the sender that the request is under review and a detailed response will follow

final_prose_output.text: Dear Sir/Madam, Thank you for your message. Please be informed that your request has been received and is currently under review. A detailed response will be provided within five working days. Kind regards.
